about: Cloth materials for a person's loose garment parts (score/stages/people_cloth, Newton's VBD, owner 2026-10-27), keyed by the library recipe a part's surface is made with (data/library/materials.json `recipes`), or by the fabric a sewn garment's surface names when it is a drawn fabric with no recipe of its own (`denim`: tools/characters/garments/fabrics.py's denim_indigo_twill): a part whose recipe has no row here is not simulated and is named. Each row: its areal density (kg/m2), its membrane's Young's modulus (N/m, the mean of warp and weft), shear modulus (N/m) and Poisson's ratio, its bending stiffness (J, the energy per squared radian of one hinge in a discrete bending model), each with its source. The stage turns them into Newton's: mu the shear modulus, lambda E nu / (1 - nu^2) (plane stress), the edge stiffness the bending stiffness over the part's mean edge length (Newton's hinge energy is half its stiffness times the edge's length times the squared angle).

cloth.is: plain woven cloth (the library's `cloth` recipe): cotton
cloth.source: Larionov, Eckert, Wolff and Stuyck, Estimating Cloth Elasticity Parameters Using Position-Based Simulation of Compliant Constrained Dynamics, arXiv:2212.08790v1 (2022), Table 2, cotton: density 0.0224 g/cm2, E_u 30823 and E_v 30266, shear 4971, Poisson 0.3058, bending 1.19. The paper names its units only as CGS. Its own loads fix the stiffnesses' scale: a 9.6 cm swatch pulled by 3 Mdyn (30 N, 312 N/m along its edge) at small strain needs E near 3e4 N/m, so the moduli are in kg/s2 (N/m) with lengths in centimetres, not g/s2 (read as g/s2, 30.5 N/m, that load would stretch it tenfold); the bending stiffness in the same units, kg cm2/s2, is 1.19e-4 J. Read again 2026-11-24 (#225): a sewn tee at the g/s2 reading slid off a shoulder and stretched 42% at its 95th percentile.

denim.source: Larionov, Eckert, Wolff and Stuyck, arXiv:2212.08790v1 (2022), Table 2, denim (the same table and units as the cotton row): density 0.0324 g/cm2, E_u 34182 and E_v 33735, shear 5592, Poisson 0.2609, bending 11.0, read as the cotton row is (moduli in N/m, bending 11.0 kg cm2/s2 = 1.10e-3 J). Read 2026-11-25 (#225): drawn as the cotton row, woman_stair_modern's jeans hung as soft as a shirt, a third lighter and bending a ninth as hard as denim, and gathered in folds at the calf as she walked.
